   * - Supports **only the following fiat currencies**:
   *   `AUD`, `BGN`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CNY`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `HUF`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`,
   *   `KRW`, `MXN`, `MYR`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `PHP`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `SGD`, `THB`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR`.

   * - Supports **only the following fiat currencies**:

   *   `KRW`, `MXN`, `MYR`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `PHP`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `SGD`, `THB`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR`.
